build_bagging_classifier: build a BaggingClassifier ensemble to reduce variance of a decision tree on classification data
build_bagging_regressor: build a BaggingRegressor ensemble to reduce variance of a regressor on regression data
train_bagging_classifier: train a BaggingClassifier on labeled data with sample weights and out-of-bag score estimation
predict_bagging_classifier: predict class probabilities using a fitted BaggingClassifier ensemble
predict_bagging_regressor: predict regression targets using a fitted BaggingRegressor ensemble
